Hæc est maledictio quæ egreditur super faciem omnis terræ:
“This is the curse that goes forth over the face of the whole earth.
For every thief will be judged,
just as it has been written there,
and everyone who swears by this,
et omnis jurans ex hoc similiter judicabitur.
will be judged in like manner.”
and it will approach to the house of the thief,

and to the house of him who swears falsely by my name,

Et egressus est angelus qui loquebatur in me,
And the angel had departed, who was speaking with me.

and see what this is, that goes forth.”
Hæc est amphora egrediens. Et dixit:
And he said, “This is a container going forth.”
Hæc est oculus eorum in universa terra.
And he said, “This is their eye in all the earth.”
And behold, a talent of lead was being carried;
et ecce mulier una sedens in medio amphoræ.
and behold, one woman sitting in the middle of the container.
Et projecit eam in medio amphoræ,
And he cast her into the middle of the container,
et misit massam plumbeam in os ejus.
and he sent the weight of lead into its mouth.
And I lifted up my eyes and I saw.
and a spirit was in their wings,
et habebant alas quasi alas milvi,
and they had wings like the wings of a kite,
et levaverunt amphoram inter terram et cælum.
and they lifted up the container between earth and heaven.
Et dixi ad angelum qui loquebatur in me:
And I said to the angel who was speaking with me,
Ut ædificetur ei domus in terra Sennaar,
“To a house that may be built for it in the land of Shinar,
and so that it may be established
et ponatur ibi super basem suam.
and set there upon its own base.”
